title: Sparkly planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd98a'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#f4a24c'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#d9682f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a83f22'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#d8f2ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fd8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- rings behind planet -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#6fc4ef' stroke-width='5' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='37' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#bfeaff' stroke-width='3' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='24' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>

  <!-- planet bands -->
  <path d='M30 44 Q50 38 70 44' stroke='#f8c76a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M31 60 Q50 66 69 60' stroke='#c25a2a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='4' fill='#e8863f'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='57' r='3' fill='#e8863f'/>

  <!-- rings in front of planet -->
  <path d='M6 52 Q50 74 94 52' fill='none' stroke='#d8f2ff' stroke-width='5' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M15 52 Q50 68 85 52' fill='none' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='3' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0'>
    <path d='M20 18 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M82 20 l1.3 3.2 3.2 1.3 -3.2 1.3 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 -3.2 -3.2 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M14 74 l1.3 3.2 3.2 1.3 -3.2 1.3 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 -3.2 -3.2 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 z'/>
    <path d='M86 70 l1.1 2.8 2.8 1.1 -2.8 1.1 -1.1 2.8 -1.1 -2.8 -2.8 -1.1 2.8 -1.1 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#b7f0ff'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='84' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='82' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='12' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
